gbm_population_evidence.quote: A previous diagnosis of GBM and who have not received prior RT or systemic therapy for their brain tumor

candidate_evidence.quote: investigate the feasibility, safety and tolerability, and establish the biological activity of nivolumab with or without relatlimab

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: To assess the pharmacokinetics (PK) of nivolumab administered with or without relatlimab during the neoadjuvant phase

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Changes in TILs in formalin-fixed paraffin embedded (FFPE) tumor sections from biopsy to resection

role_evidence.quote: Part 1 Adjuvant Treatment: Patient will receive 480 mg of nivolumab and 380 mg of relatimab for up to 12 cycles
all 92 patients will receive single dose of 480 mg by IV infusion on Day 1 followed by surgery.
For Neoadjuvant treatment, only on Arm 2, 69 patients will receive a single dose of 480 mg of nivolumab and 480 mg of relatimab
All patients in safety lead-in, Arm 1 and Arm 2 post resection in Part 1 Adjuvant Treatment setting will receive 75 mg/m2 TMZ from Day 1 to Day 42 orally.

source_quote.quote: TMZ will be omitted in MGMT unmethylated patients
patients with isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH) wildtype newly diagnosed glioblastoma (ndGBM)
Changes in TILs in formalin-fixed paraffin embedded (FFPE) tumor sections from biopsy to resection

coder_notes: Both arms are labelled experimental: Arm 1 neoadjuvant nivolumab alone, Arm 2 nivolumab + relatlimab; all patients get both in adjuvant phases, so both coded experimental_combination. TMZ given only to MGMT-methylated patients in Part 1 (omitted if unmethylated); MGMT coded enrichment for TMZ use, not a candidate match. IDH-wildtype stated in brief summary only, not in eligibility list. PK sample type not stated. TILs pre/post tumour sampling = pharmacodynamic objective.
